overrides.tagline: A second-hand car marketplace on React and Firebase
overrides.summary: A web app for buying and selling second-hand cars — React and Tailwind CSS on Firebase, with real-time listings in Cloud Firestore and email or Google sign-in.
description: Buying or selling a used car usually means chasing listings across classifieds, phone calls and messages. Carspace collects them in one marketplace.

Built with React and Tailwind CSS on Firebase: listings live in Cloud Firestore and update in real time, and users sign in with email or Google through Firebase Authentication. It's hosted on Firebase.

features.title: New and used
features.desc: Separate tabs for new and pre-owned cars.

features.title: Search and budget filter
features.desc: Search by car name and set a price range with a slider.

features.title: Real-time listings
features.desc: Cloud Firestore pushes listing changes to every open browser.

features.title: Accounts
features.desc: Email or Google sign-in with Firebase Authentication.

challenge: Second-hand car listings are scattered across classifieds and word of mouth, and buyers can't easily filter what fits their budget.
The goal was a simple marketplace where listings stay current without anyone refreshing, on infrastructure a solo developer could run.

screens.caption: The home page: new / used tabs, search by name and a price-range filter.
Sign-in with email or Google through Firebase Authentication.
